notes.title: Kick Bot - Dev Update - New Camera Sneak Peek Video
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=CytNXfkiuD8;full][/previewyoutube]

We have been hard at work revamping the camera in Kick Bot and fine-tuning each level. The new camera (coming soon) will show you more of what is coming up and give you a better view of the entire room you are in. This has been no easy task but is one of the most comprehensive upgrades we have worked on for the game.

Wishlist Kick Bot on Steam for updates: http://wishlist.kickbotgame.com

Stay tuned for a new demo to drop on the Kick Bot steam page when we are done with the camera update, and if you are part of our beta a new beta build will be coming soon as well.

Speaking of the Kick Bot beta, if you are interested in trying out 70+ full levels of Kick Bot head over to our Discord and sign up today! 

[url=http://discord.gg/twoscoopgames][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35643713/cc50d9642fb294d652882ef4f5788cc6fe892071.png[/img][/url]
